walkthrough.short: Actives pass through across, cast round the dancer one place along, and come into the middle.
walkthrough.long: The active couple passes through across the set, right shoulders, then turns right and casts round the dancer standing one place along the line they have arrived on, going outside the line. They come back into the middle of the set and stop a long way apart, facing each other along the set. The two who stood still are now the sides of a diamond and the two actives are its points.

call.long: PASS THROUGH ACROSS AND CAST INTO DIAMONDS
